# FeedXchange

> FeedXchange (feedxchange.in) is India's first dedicated B2B digital marketplace for animal feed ingredients. Feed mills, poultry, fish, prawn and cattle farms buy raw materials such as de-oiled cakes (DOC), soybean meal, DDGS, de-oiled rice bran (DORB), maize and edible oils from KYC-verified sellers, with live indicative prices, contract tracking and truck logistics on one platform.

Key facts:

- Operator: built and run by Sri Sai Raghavendra Trade Services, feed raw material traders since 1996.
- Office: 174, 1st floor, Mahatma Gandhi Wholesale Commercial Complex, Mahendra Nagar, Gollapudi, Vijayawada, Andhra Pradesh 521225, India. Serves buyers and sellers across India.
- Contact: +91 92475 98399 (phone and WhatsApp), contact@feedxchange.in, Monday to Saturday 9am to 6pm IST.
- Who can register: feed manufacturers, poultry farms, fish and prawn farms, cattle feed plants, ingredient sellers, transporters and referral aggregators. Registration and use of the portal are currently free.
- Prices shown are indicative (usually ex-factory or ex-warehouse, before GST and freight); the final price is confirmed when the contract is executed.
- Payments for goods go directly from the buyer's bank account to the supplier's; FeedXchange is not a payment gateway. A canvassing / service fee may apply under the trading agreement.
- Quality disputes are mediated by FeedXchange; proven poor quality results in a debit to the supplier.
